accepted_registry_records.summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_UNSELECTED_NOT_TESTED. In one complete Lonitzer Dipsacus entry, leaf juice is said to kill ear worms; distilled water is said to help mouth ulcers; water resting on the leaves is assigned eye and facial uses. These are distinct liquid bearers and routes, not a generic interchangeable WATER product. This source-bound distinction is separate from IDEA000808, which follows the leaf-bearing water across two sites but does not compare it with the separately named distillate and juice. No target meaning is assigned.
accepted_registry_records.title: RAW_UNREVIEWED: Dipsacus names three different liquid bearers with different source operations and uses
